common.unsubscribe: To unsubscribe from these emails, click here.

staffInvitation.subject: You've been invited to join the {clubName} team
staffInvitation.title: Team invitation
staffInvitation.body: {inviterName} invited you to join the {clubName} team on {appNameDisplay}.
staffInvitation.securityWordNote: Remember the security word you agreed on with your administrator.
staffInvitation.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.title: Reset password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request this change, ignore this email.

userRegistration.subject: Confirm your account
userRegistration.title: Confirm your email
userRegistration.body: To finish creating your account, confirm your email with the link below.
userRegistration.ignore: If you didn't create an account, ignore this email.

connection.subject: Code to connect Mercado Pago
connection.title: Confirm your Mercado Pago connection
connection.body: Use this code to connect your Mercado Pago account.

disconnection.subject: Code to disconnect Mercado Pago
disconnection.title: Confirm your Mercado Pago disconnection
disconnection.body: Use this code to disconnect your Mercado Pago account.

mercadoPagoConnectionOtp.ignore: If you didn't request this action, ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {appNameDisplay}
welcome.title: Welcome, {name}!
welcome.body: Your account was created successfully. You can now sign in.
